vectors.name: placeholder_stripped_fields_survive
vectors.note: the legacy placeholder key is stripped and every other field (sibling namespace field, doc-level title) survives the re-marshal roundtrip

vectors.name: real_url_untouched
vectors.note: a real-URL document is not a repair: raw is returned byte for byte and no write-back happens

vectors.name: mixed_sources_half_repaired
vectors.note: a mixed-source document is half-repaired: only the placeholder namespace's poster key dies, the real-URL namespace keeps its poster untouched

vectors.name: relative_placeholder_stripped
vectors.note: relative form (rows enriched before the absolute-URL helper): the PATH prefix /assets/globals/missing is the rule, no scheme or host required
